title: Lambda Expressions
description: Compact way to represent functional interfaces.
code:
Runnable r = () -> System.out.println("Running in a lambda!");
new Thread(r).start();
explanation_md: Lambdas provide a concise syntax for implementing single-method interfaces (Functional Interfaces).

title: Singleton Pattern
description: Ensuring a class has only one instance.
explanation_md: The Singleton pattern restricts the instantiation of a class to one "single" instance.
